entries.why: THE CAMPUS CAP NEEDS A DOOR TO THE SCREEN THAT SELLS A CAMPUS. At its campus limit, AdminChurches used to disable "Add church" and hang a title on it reading "Your plan includes 1 church. Upgrade to Ministry to add more." That sentence was FALSE - maxChurches is 1 on every tier, Ministry included, because Ministry deliberately did not inherit the deleted ultra tier's -1 - and it was also unreachable on touch, since a title needs a hover and a disabled button never fires its own onClick. The cap is a thing to BUY, not a wall, so the button now opens an offer that names the live campus price read from /api/dodo/addons and routes the church to the add-ons surface. THE EDIT TO THIS FILE IS ONE PROP on the existing <AdminChurches /> mount: onOpenBilling, wired to the SAME expression the account menu already passes for its own Billing row - billingAccess === 'yes' ? () => setShowBilling(true) : undefined - so an admin whose billing access has not settled to 'yes' still receives undefined and the offer renders no button to a screen they cannot open. NO NEW CAPABILITY AND NO NEW STATE: setShowBilling and billingAccess both already existed in this file for the account menu, and this is a second reader of them. Nothing else here moves - no nav array, no group, no tab id, no permission gate, no render arm, no import, and no screen mount is added or removed.
